description.zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
description.en: The current page number. This field is present when pagination is used.

description.zh: 通过实例id或实例名称过滤，支持模糊查询
description.en: Filters instances by instance ID or instance name. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 通过实例的插件安装状态过滤实例
description.en: Filters instances by plug-in installation status.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 指定本参数则过滤出指定Agent的实例列表
description.en: Filters the instance list by the specified agent. If this parameter is specified, only instances associated with the specified agent are returned.

title.en: Retrieve instance list of a component

descriptions.zh: 当前接口获取的实例列表是已经被 SysOM 纳管的机器列表，如果某个ECS实例存在但是没有被 SysOM 纳管，则不会出现在列表当中。
descriptions.en: The instance list retrieved by this operation contains only machines that are managed by SysOM. If an ECS instance exists but is not managed by SysOM, it does not appear in the list.
